files.scripts/build-with-builder.js: Delegates backend preparation to prepare-aioncore. Do not restore a direct upstream download here.
files.packages/desktop/electron-builder.yml: Bundled AionCore must ship from resources/bundled-aioncore. Keep the repository pinned to the fork release feed.
files.package.json: Keep the 8 GB heap build scripts and the native:node / native:electron ABI helpers.
files.packages/desktop/src/process/utils/runBa: buildDefaultMcpServers must stay minimal: chrome-devtools plus the built-in browser only. External sample servers cause permanent disconnected entries because bootstrap reseeds any missing default by name.
files.tests/unit/process/task/kanban-e2e-ativi: Keep the fixed reference clock, explicit due-soon window, seeded card offsets, and per-run isolated temporary database directory.
files.packages/desktop/src/renderer/pages/kanb: Renderer Kanban client aligned with the real repository column names.
files.mcp.config.json: Machine-local MCP server catalog backup. Never wire it as an automatically consumed app config.
files.scripts/upgrade-seguro.ps1: Safe upgrade flow: never use reset, clean, or force. Abort on the first problem.
